name: remote-relay
description: Over Remote Control, posts other mods' toasts, notifications, status changes and dialogs as transcript notices every device shows

mirror.title: When to mirror
mirror.description: remote: only where no screen draws the session (Remote Control). always: also where a terminal draws it, so a phone attached to a terminal session sees the same, at the cost of each line twice there.

digest.title: After each reply
digest.description: reply: after every reply, post all status lines mods have pinned (keepwarm and the like) in one notice, numbers included. off: post a line only when its state changes.
